curve_coverage.finding: The preserved archive is almost complete for M1-M12 but the old absolute-expiry capture boundary materially over-captured far contracts.

field_value.finding: Settlement and contract-level volume are materially non-redundant fields for futures roll and curve research.

screening_experiment.target: next observed session same-contract front-month settlement return; roll-boundary targets excluded
screening_experiment.method: expanding-window standardized Ridge/LogisticRegression; fixed regularization; no strategy optimization
screening_experiment.conclusion: No demonstrated next-session return or direction advantage from the richer curve fields. Volatility/absolute-return improvement versus price-only is small and statistically uncertain on two years of data.

advanced.history: 7+ years via plan summary; NYMEX session flat files list all available history

decision.basic: KEEP FOR EVALUATION: sufficient for the current two-year end-of-session contract/settlement/volume research path.
decision.starter: DO NOT BUY FOR RESEARCH HISTORY: no history-depth improvement over Basic; throughput is not currently the limiting factor.
decision.developer: ONLY PAID PLAN WORTH A BOUNDED NEXT TEST: five years would test whether the weak volatility signal is regime-robust and materially expands training/evaluation history.
decision.advanced: NOT JUSTIFIED YET: do not pay for real-time/all-history features until five-year evidence demonstrates value and licensing is resolved.
